properties.evidence: The older thought, grown up. That node listed 'export on every write' as road 1 and recorded it as dead, on the ground that a whole-document write is fatal on a per-change path. A full export measured 1,168 ms when that was written and 265 ms after #330 and the BTreeMap backend change, so the road reopens on a number rather than on an argument — and it reopens with a new distinction the original road did not have: write to the working tree, not to git history.
